status: unverified (decision 11): element list from docs/SPEC.md Section 9; not checked by a lawyer

elements.title: Cheque drawn for discharge of a legally enforceable debt or liability

source.quote: for the discharge, in whole or in part, of any debt or other liability

elements.title: Cheque presented within its validity period

source.quote: the cheque has been presented to the bank within a period of six months from the date on which it is drawn

elements.title: Cheque returned unpaid for insufficient funds or exceeding arrangement

source.quote: the amount of money standing to the credit of that account is insufficient to honour the cheque or that it exceeds the amount arranged to be paid from that account

elements.title: Written demand notice sent within the statutory period

source.quote: makes a demand for the payment of the said amount of money by giving a notice; in writing, to the drawer of the cheque

elements.title: Drawer failed to pay within the statutory period after notice

source.quote: the drawer of such cheque fails to make the payment of the said amount of money

elements.title: Complaint filed within the statutory period

source.quote: such complaint is made within one month of the date on which the cause of action arises
the branch of the bank where the payee or holder in due course, as the case may be, maintains the account, is situated
